page.layout: Running head at top, with page number left and title right. Main text in one column on the right, with a centred section heading in the middle of the column. Marginal notes in the left margin, three of them (two at upper-left, one at mid-left, one lower-left). Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: Ditabunt nos (Dei virtute) lites istæ magno fœnore, veritatis ac gloriæ.
main_text.head: SECT. IV. Quàm non sufficit eiusdem Symboli Confessio.
main_text.p: Lib. de offic. boni viri.AT omnium, illud, non vnius Cassandri in ore est. Communis fidei tessera symbolum est; idemque nos vno ore omnes, lubentissimè profitemur. Certè, Theodoretus cùm Antiochenorum acerrimè contendentium inimicitias, stylo minuere vellet: Erat (inquit) vtriusque partis, vna Theod. hist. l. 3. c. 4.

page.notes: Left margin notes are printed in small italic type: upper-left note is a faded, partly illegible manuscript-like marginal note (show-through from the other side, not transcribed). The "Lib. de offic. boni viri." and "Theod. hist. l. 3. c. 4." notes are given at their places. The initial "A" is a large woodcut-style initial joined to "T" of "Tomnium" as printed ("AT omnium"). Faint show-through text from the reverse page appears across the column and is not transcribed.
